profile.headline: .Gov Web Developer
profile.summary: Mr. Rubino currently possesses an active TS Clearance with the DoD. With over 20 years of specialized experience in website development, he has expertise in 508 Compliance, Drupal website development adhering to best practices and coding standards, and SEO. Most recently, Mr. Rubino has served as Team Lead overseeing Drupal development projects for multiple government agency customers providing full web design and development, digital media, and end-to-end website management support.

positions.title: .Gov Web Developer
positions.description: Mr. Rubino provides ongoing support and conveying best practices, 508 compliance, WCAG2.1 and Drupal to USPS OIG / CIGIE their online web sites www.ignet.gov and www.oversight.gov. He leads a team of four Drupal developers to support various Inspector General offices federal wide by developing new Office of Inspector General responsive web sites built in Drupal 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 utilizing custom themes based on the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS), 508 Compliance, and WCAG2.1. He provides monthly web site usage reports from Google Analytics and other sources of internal and external information to identify sources of improvement. He also proactively provides support which include the following: API imports and exports, CIGIE directory updates, job postings, new feature requests, security updates, bugfixes, automated test scripts (Playwright), quality improvements, technical training, feature enhancements and other various web development tasks. Mr. Rubino has also provided the team with process improvements in development workflows, peer reviews, 508 compliance, and Drupal web site building best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Drupal · Twig · Drush · Node.js · Uswds · JavaScript

positions.title: Director of Recruitment
positions.description: I am responsible for understanding the volunteer needs of the organization and working closely with leadership to identify areas where volunteers can make a meaningful impact.

positions.title: Mid-Senior Drupal Developer
positions.description: Provides ongoing support and conveying Drupal best usage practices to USPS OIG / CIGIE regarding their public facing web sites. Supports various Inspector General offices federal wide by developing new Office of Inspector General responsive web sites built in Drupal utilizing custom themes based on the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS).

positions.title: Mid-Senior Drupal Developer
positions.description: I supported DHS and their online web sites www.us-cert.gov and www.cisa.gov. Communicated with the customer and web development team insuring continuity of information and requirements. I am responsible for creating weekly status reports regarding the project which are provided to upper management. The team works daily in a Certsion Control System (Git) and provides Drupal 8 solutions which include date, display, UI, and information architecture. I also develop responsive web sites using Drupal 8, Twig, Bootstrap 3, HTML, CSS, SASS, JavaScript, and JQuery.

positions.title: Webmaster / Drupal Developer
positions.description: I was responsible for overseeing web operations for the Strategic Systems Programs Department of Navy. In this capacity, I would coordinate the efforts of more than 70 Government web managers who are designated to develop and maintain content for the agency’s Intranet. In this role I developed courses and provides classroom training to the web managers to better utilize the Drupal 8 driven Content Management System (CMS) in a client facing environment. I was responsible for the software configuration management processes and overseeing of 15+ responsive web sites/portals that include 12,000+ web pages. I would design, redesign, enhances user experience, develops, and supports online responsive applications used throughout the enterprise. I also provided all digital media support, including creating, manipulating and publishing videos, audio, presentations, announcements and advertisements required by the Government Agency. I was also responsible for managing and maintaining IIS and Apache Tomcat web servers to ensure optimized performance and remediating IT security vulnerabilities defined by DISA's Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG).

positions.title: Lead Frontend Developer, Media Specialist
positions.description: I was the lead front end developer that performed day-to-day tasks for the Department of Housing & Urban Development (HUD) web sites. He was responsible for analyzing client requests, completing work orders, developing new designs and templates for on the web team content managers to utilize. I was responsible for 125,000+ hud.gov web pages including 5,000+ HUD Intranet files and 10,000+ HUD Espanol web pages. He performed Quality Assurance on all task requests to ensure compliance with Section 508 Accessibility Standards. also created and provided annual classroom training for the Government web team on HUD web standards, best practices, and how to use software. I worked with the project manager to develop and execute a plan of action for the HUD Intranet (HUD@WORK) redesign / migration. I was promoted to the migration and frontend development team lead.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer and Media Specialist
positions.description: I was the primary full stack developer for Solutions Web Design, LLC where I was responsible for the full lifecycle of web site development projects. In addition, I was a digital media specialist and worked directly with customers to provide layered mock up designs of web sites, print media, logos, and animated graphics. I would also consulted with sales and marketing personnel to assist with cost estimating of new projects in proposals. During my tenure, I designed and developed 15 small business static and php driven web sites, created custom animations and Adobe Flash based applications with ActionScript, developed custom PHP / MYSQL content management systems, created custom audio files and video files, and designed print media (Business Cards, Brochures, Yard Signs, Letterheads, and Logos).

honors.title: Core Value Award for Excellence
honors.description: I embody the spirit of innovation and creative problem-solving, always growing and improving your knowledge and skills and pushing others to do the same. Excellence inspires us to find new ways to address evolving challenges. It prompts us to surpass our past successes, cultivate a spirit of innovation within our teams, and find new ways to improve our knowledge and skills.

volunteerExperiences.description: I am currently assisting on the Drupal GovCon planning committe for the 2020 Drupal GovCon Conference
I am the official event photographer for the 2019 Drupal GovCon 2019 and upcoming Drupal GovCon 2020 events. Photographs were supplied to the speakers, and to Drupal4Gov to promote future events.
